ignoreCommand: if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ]; then git -c http.extraHeader="Authorization: Basic $(printf 'x-access-token:%s' "$DEPLOY_GUARD_TOKEN" | base64 | tr -d '\n')" fetch -q --unshallow "${GITHUB_SERVER_URL:-https://github.com}/$VERCEL_GIT_REPO_OWNER/$VERCEL_GIT_REPO_SLUG.git" "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" 2>/dev/null; fi; if [ -n "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" ] && git rev-list --first-parent "$VERCEL_GIT_COMMIT_SHA" | grep -x "$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA" > /dev/null && g=$(mktemp) && curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_GUARD_TOKEN" -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw' -o "$g" "${GITHUB_API_URL:-https://api.github.com}/repos/$VERCEL_GIT_REPO_OWNER/$VERCEL_GIT_REPO_SLUG/contents/.sdd/bin/deploy-guard.sh?ref=$VERCEL_GIT_PREVIOUS_SHA"; then bash "$g" --vercel {{VERCEL_PATHS}}; [ $? -ne 1 ]; fi
